basic_details.job_title: AUD Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi has invited applications for the post of Research Assistant in an ICSSR-funded project titled "Aligning Traditional Knowledge System and Modern Sustainable Livelihood Practices with Viksit Bharat vision for Resilient North-Eastern Communities: A Longitudinal Empirical Study" under the Special Call for VIKSIT BHARAT@2024. Eligible candidates may submit their applications online through the official form by 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About AUD Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi is conducting this recruitment for a temporary project position funded by the Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR). The selected Research Assistant will be appointed for an initial period of 2 months, which is extendable as per project requirements, under the leadership of Project Director and Coordinator Prof. (Dr.) Anu Singh Lather.

content_sections.heading: AUD Research Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Ph.D., M.Phil., or Postgraduate degree in a social science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month. The tenure of the appointment is 2 months, which is extendable as per the operational needs of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AUD Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Access the official application link provided in the official notification. Fill out the required details in the online application form. Prepare a Curriculum Vitae (CV) and relevant certificates indicating qualifications. Upload or submit the application along with the CV and certificates via the online portal.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the university website for updates regarding the interview date and time.
